_comment: What tools/resource-ledger.py cannot read from the data. Every gap entry needs its reason.
structures: the name a structure or gate site goes by in the ledger.
equipment: items a player uses directly, so they need a source but no use. Named one by one: a 'namespace:*' here would let a new component or material skip the use check.
used_by_code: items code consumes, with what it does. They count as used.
tag_uses: item tags code reads, with what membership does.
no_source_yet / no_use_yet: known gaps, with the reason and where the fix is planned.
creative_only: items with no survival source on purpose, and why.

used_by_code.ascension_combat:tome_of_scrapping: Used up at an anvil to wipe an item's enchantments (TomeAnvil)
used_by_code.ascension_combat:tome_of_extraction: Used up in a crafting grid to move an item's enchantments onto a book (ExtractionRecipe)
used_by_code.ascension_combat:rune_chalk: Spent, with experience levels, by a rune page save that removes or replaces a rune (RuneChangeCost)
used_by_code.ascension_worlds:warden_tendril: Wakes Earth's player-built gate, one tendril per gate (GatewayPortalActivation)
